readingCredentialPolicy: Import stores the complete bounded document only in the encrypted role-scoped database. A chat request sends only the explicitly selected passage after rechecking the document identity, scope, range, text and hash; the internal document UUID is not included in model text.
limitations: Static APK marker scan. Device database, WAL, cache, Keystore files, file picker behavior, SQLCipher migration and live provider requests require a connected device or controlled endpoint.
